name: document-analysis
description: Document-to-Markdown ingestion for the document-analysis pipeline. Wraps Microsoft's MarkItDown (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, CSV/JSON/XML, EPub) with batch folder conversion, YAML frontmatter, a hash-based manifest for idempotent re-runs, per-file error isolation, and optional LLM image descriptions + OCR via the team OpenRouter key.
